== Reconciliation status, 5 November 2026 ==

All 133 comparison rows below now have a disposition: 26 different-name cases, four spelling cases, 30 qualifier cases and 73 punctuation/formatting cases. Different published titles have separate full card articles; caption mistakes and data errors do not establish another playable state. The GEMP column is the original 4 November 2026 audit snapshot, not a current implementation report.

Five later-name alternate images have no earlier-name AI counterpart established in the inspected release sheets: [[Maris Brood, Fallen Jedi (V) (AI)]], [[Galen Marek, Starkiller (V) (AI)]], [[Jango Fett, The Assassin (V) (AI)]], [[Kyle Katarn (V) (AI)]], and [[Errant Venture (V) (AI)]]. Their Talk pages retain those unresolved source questions. The earlier [[Black Leader (V) (AI)]] is present in the release sheet and has its own article. Three older shield images disagree with the official shield sheet; the official sheet is displayed and the conflicts remain on the card Talk pages. Dates of individual changes and intermediate game-text revisions remain part of the wider [[Virtual Legacy]] publication-history work.

== How the list was built ==
* Every one of the 1,203 Legacy printings: the PC title<ref name="pcjson" /> against the heading on its official sheet.
* Every Legacy card's game text, on the sheets and in the PC data, searched for both names of each card in tables A and B.
* GEMP titles read from master (after [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/pull/482 PR #482]) and from the unmerged branches legacy/p-vb7-2-a, legacy/p-vb7-2-light-b and legacy/p-vb7-1-dark-a named in Claude's handoff on swccg-guild/work issue #5 (a private repository).<ref name="hw71" />
